entities.summary: Alqama ibn Qays al-Nakha'i (d. 62 AH was a well-known scholar from among the taba'een and pupil of Abd-Allah ibn Mas'ud, who called him the most erudite of his disciples. He also related traditions from Ali ibn Abi Talib, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas and `Uthman.
